question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Walked**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **walked **is the past form of word walk.
 
• The word **walk **is a verb which means to lift and lower each foot in turn, moving at a consistent pace, never lifting both feet off the ground at once.
 
• *Examples* - **Walk** : Lets go for an evening **walk**, **Walked **- He **walked **towards me and hugged me.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **Stalked **is an adjective which means a series of unwelcome actions intended at one individual in particular that prompts them to alter their routine or feel scared, anxious, or in danger

*Example*: I **stalked **that boy sometimes.

 
• The word **Danced **is past form of word dance which means move in time with the music, usually by performing a predetermined order of actions.

*Example* : We **danced **a lot yesterday night.

 
• The word **Slept **is past tense of word sleep which means be sleeping; be in a condition of slumber.

*Example* : I **slept **early yesterday.
